preconditions.description: The length of pat is greater than or equal to 1 and less than the length of txt
The length of txt is between 1 and 10^5

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(index, int) for index in result)
all(1 <= index <= len(txt) for index in result)
postconditions.description: Each index is a 1-based index within txt

postconditions.expression: result == [] or all(txt.startswith(pat, index - 1) for index in result)
postconditions.description: Each index in result is the start of an occurrence of pat in txt

postconditions.expression: result == [] or not any(txt.startswith(pat, index - 1) for index in range(len(txt) - len(pat) + 1))
postconditions.description: There are no occurrences of pat in txt not listed in result
